title: Keep the item bank behind sign-in
statement: Keep a scored test's item bank behind sign-in, because an open route lets anyone harvest its items.
detail: A reading assessment's live deployment gates its direct no-login route behind a flag that is off by default, so that the item bank cannot be farmed anonymously, while students sit the test through a sign-in route (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/map-proxy-assessment/validity/MAP_PROXY_VALIDITY_CASE.md`). Its approval case lists the gate among what is live and verifiable today (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/map-proxy-assessment/validity/00_CASE_FOR_APPROVAL.md`).

evidence.quote: The full adaptive test is live. The direct no-login route is gated behind the `PUBLIC_TEST_ENABLED` flag (default off) so the item bank cannot be farmed anonymously:
Redirects to Cognito SSO → authenticated adaptive session
• Public /test route gated behind a flag so the item bank cannot be farmed anonymously.
